## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Describe the use case or pain point clearly.

## Proposed Solution

What should the feature look like? Be specific about expected behavior.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches have you considered? Why is this one better?

## Impact on Existing Functionality

- [ ] Backwards compatible (no breaking changes)
- [ ] May require database migration
- [ ] May require new environment variables
- [ ] May require dependency changes

## Additional Context

Any references, screenshots, or examples from other projects that illustrate the idea.
